# arin_whois_net_parent (Data Source)

List Whois-RWS parent related to a net registration. References are returned by default; show_details requests expanded records. Parent-network lookups always return a full record in a list. POC role links remain distinct. No API key is sent. Partial responses and referrals are rejected; recognized no-results responses require an existing owner before returning an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
data "arin_whois_net_parent" "example" {
  handle       = "NET-192-0-2-0-1"
  show_details = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `handle` (String) ARIN registration handle.

### Optional

- `show_details` (Boolean) Ask ARIN to expand related information inline. Complete XML preserves extra records; any nested truncation is rejected. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `networks` (Attributes List) Related records ordered deterministically. Distinct POC role links are preserved. Reference responses omit detail-only fields; show_details requests full records. Confirmed no matches produce an empty list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))
- `whois_xml` (String) Complete relationship response XML, including references, expanded records and extensions. Null for a confirmed empty HTTP 404 response. Links are not followed.

<a id="nestedatt--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (List of String) Ordered lines of comments.
- `customer_handle` (String) customer handle returned by ARIN.
- `end_address` (String) end address returned by ARIN.
- `handle` (String) handle returned by ARIN.
- `ip_version` (String) ip version returned by ARIN.
- `name` (String) name returned by ARIN.
- `net_blocks` (Attributes List) net blocks returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks--net_blocks))
- `org_handle` (String) org handle returned by ARIN.
- `parent_handle` (String) parent handle returned by ARIN.
- `poc_functions` (List of String) Sorted POC association function codes. Reference links retain their function; expanded POCs collect functions from inline links to the requested owner.
- `rdap_ref` (String) rdap ref returned by ARIN.
- `ref` (String) ref returned by ARIN.
- `reference_name` (String) reference name returned by ARIN.
- `registration_date` (String) registration date returned by ARIN.
- `related_poc_handle` (String) related poc handle returned by ARIN.
- `related_poc_name` (String) related poc name returned by ARIN.
- `start_address` (String) start address returned by ARIN.
- `update_date` (String) update date returned by ARIN.
